category_title: Students who use physical presence and threats to intimidate faculty
scenario_title: Public verbal assault and dominance displays in class
minimal_context: The student arrives in the classroom during general instruction and confronts the professor in front of the other students.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Good morning everyone. Please take your seats so we can begin today's lecture.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slams textbook on the desk and refuses to return to his seat, standing in a power stance looking down to communicate dominance) I'm not sitting down.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I need you to go to your seat now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Uses a 'size up and down' nonverbal look at the professor) No.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We can discuss any issues after class. Let's move on.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yells out to the class) She is the worst teacher in the world! Don't pay attention to anything she says. She's stupid.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Good morning everyone. Please take your seats so we can begin today's lecture.

STUDENT: (Slams textbook on the desk and refuses to return to his seat, standing in a power stance looking down to communicate dominance) I'm not sitting down.

TUTOR: I need you to go to your seat now.

STUDENT: (Uses a 'size up and down' nonverbal look at the professor) No.

TUTOR: We can discuss any issues after class. Let's move on.

STUDENT: (Yells out to the class) She is the worst teacher in the world! Don't pay attention to anything she says. She's stupid.

context.social_setting: In front of other students in the class

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Showing up to class to continue the onslaught after resorting to profanity via email
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: He yelled out to my class that I was ‘the worst teacher in the world’ and ‘don’t pay attention to anything she says. She’s stupid.’
related_quotes: the worst teacher in the world

behavior_patterns.condition: After refusing to turn to return to his seat.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Power stances where the bully looks down or nonverbally communicates dominance. One student bully on his way out of the classroom used the ‘size up and down’ nonverbal
